links.comparator_used: Prompt A: default prompt asking for a novel ROP patient education material with no reading-level instruction
links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education materials (SMOG, FKGL)
links.effect: Prompt B (6th-grade target using SMOG) generated more readable PEMs than Prompt A (P < .001)
links.quote: Prompt B generated more readable PEMs than Prompt A (P < .001).

links.comparator_used: Original human-written ROP patient education materials found via Google search
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, SMOG) of LLM-rewritten PEMs versus original PEMs
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 and Gemini rewrites reduced readability from baseline FKGL 8.8 ± 1.9 and SMOG 8.6 ± 1.5 to the targeted 6th-grade level
links.tradeoff: Only ChatGPT-4 rewrites maintained high quality and reliability (median DISCERN = 4), so the Gemini rewrites did not keep quality and reliability.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 and Gemini rewrote PEMs (Prompt C) from a baseline readability level (FKGL: 8.8 ± 1.9, SMOG: 8.6 ± 1.5) to the targeted 6th-grade reading level.
